title: Habit tracker
request: Write a short setup guide for the habit tracker.

features.title: Setup guide for new users
features.story: As a new user I can follow a short guide to install the app and add my first habit.
acceptance: The guide is a list of numbered steps, and each step is one action.
The guide says how to start the app and what the reader should see when it works.
The guide explains how to add a first habit.
The guide does not name any file or setting that the project does not have.

attempts.summary: Mission Control's own checks found a problem

results.evidence: Quote from docs/setup.md: the steps are numbered 1 to 5.
The guide never says what the reader should see when it works.
Step 4 explains how to add a first habit.
Every file named in the guide is in the project.
